integrity: The standalone verifier reconstructs the 18-arc complex and its explicit 336-pair Morse matching, integer attaching-degree matrices, a unit minor and zero final top differential. The recorded output is reproducible from included code and certificate; no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite graph-specific homotopy classification; no result for all bidirected complete bipartite digraphs or for equivariant homology. An unindexed equivalent computation remains a literature risk. The integral homotopy proof relies on complete enumerable integer Morse cancellation and standard CW homotopy theory.
title: Mixed-dimensional integral multipath homotopy of the bidirected \(K_{3,3}\)
